scope: the 196 atoms scored by default (stratum content, not deferred, not merged, not an umbrella); the 124 other atoms keep human_review = pending

method: 22 Oct 2026: labels proposed by Claude subagents from the staged inputs (input_evidence.raw / .consolidation, unchanged here).

1 Nov 2026, review A (Claude, blind): eight Claude annotators labelled the 196 atoms from the standard-form statements and the plain-text runtime inputs (raw and consolidation), without the 22 Oct labels, anchor quotes or reference documents; every quoted passage machine-checked verbatim (whitespace-insensitive), 196/196 atoms, 0 failures. Rules given: a passage must exist verbatim; a bare mention is partial (flag bare_mention).
1 Nov 2026, review B (GPT Astra, raw inputs only, the 22 Oct labels and passages visible): docs/reviews/2026-11-01-label-review.md.

2 Nov 2026: consolidation. A = B on 155 of 196; 41 differences in three kinds: 7 bare-mention rows (rule), 9 rows whose support is only in a consolidation input (A judged raw + consolidation, B raw only), 25 judgment rows.

3 Nov 2026: owner decisions, without re-reading the sources: bare mention suffices for supported (the 7 rows); the consolidation inputs count (the 9 rows: combined = supported, raw = B's label); judgment rows: supported where A held against B (15), A's concessions to B accepted (10). The owner then skimmed all 196 rows and changed nothing else.

rules_in_force.1_verbatim: A passage counts only if it exists verbatim in the input text (whitespace differences allowed).
rules_in_force.2_bare_mention: A bare mention of the information item in the inputs (a field or element name in a list or schema) suffices for supported; no stated need, obligation or purpose is required. Decided 3 Nov; review A had applied the stricter reading.
rules_in_force.3_condition: Proposed (a missing condition or scope makes the label partial) and not adopted. Three concessions of review A to partial on that ground (H-13.1, H-27.1, H-37.3) stand by the owner's confirmation.
rules_in_force.4_two_corpora: Raw and consolidation labels are kept separately; the combined label counts support in either corpus.

limits: Two AI reviews and an owner adjudication, not a human annotation of each atom against the sources. Review B was not blind. No second human annotator; the Claude-Astra agreement is the only agreement figure.
